conviction_note: Day two of a patent-loss collapse. The cause is fully public: the 2026-09-30 ruling plus the sell-side cuts before today's open. The decisive next event (the parties' proposed remedies, with United Therapeutics asking for an injunction) is due about 2026-10-07, after the window. Nothing dated lands on 2026-10-02, so the only in-window item is the analysts still to update. p_up is 46 on abs 7%.

cause.label: litigation_or_regulatory
cause.what_happened: On 2026-09-30 a Delaware court held claims 1 and 14 of United Therapeutics' '327 patent (PH-ILD use of inhaled dry-powder treprostinil) valid and infringed by YUTREPIA, and the stock fell 57%. Before the 2026-10-01 open BofA, BTIG, Raymond James and Needham cut, and the stock gapped -20.6%. It then recovered +10.4% intraday to -12.4% at the 15:04 ET screen, on 17x normal volume.

evidence.claim: Court found claims 1 and 14 of the '327 patent valid and infringed. Remedy undecided. Parties to submit a form of judgment with proposed remedies within one week. UTHR sought an injunction restricting YUTREPIA's availability. Liquidia will appeal and file an sNDA to remove PH-ILD from the label
BofA cut its target to $40 from $92 (Neutral). BTIG downgraded to Neutral. Raymond James downgraded to Outperform and cut its target to $53
BofA: PH-ILD is about half of current YUTREPIA sales. BTIG: the remedy could include an immediate halt across indications. RBC: judgment expected in about one week

pipeline.next_dated_event: Parties' form of judgment with proposed remedies, due within one week of 2026-09-30, so about 2026-10-07 (after the window)
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An early filing of either side's proposed judgment, or a UTHR motion for immediate injunctive relief, docketed on 2026-10-02, or Liquidia announcing that it has filed the PH-ILD label-removal sNDA (which would narrow the remedy fight).

positioning_check: Short interest 12,377,976 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, 11.4 days to cover, +4.4% against 2026-08-31 (Nasdaq/FINRA, https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/LQDA/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). This is two weeks before the ruling and lags about 8 business days, so the covering on the 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01 volume cannot be observed. Options: the front chain is unusable (no two-sided ATM quotes), so there is no implied move or skew. Put/call OI is 0.86 on 46,444 contracts (baseline). Institutional ownership is 64.5% (MarketBeat, 2026-10-01). Insiders: 0 open-market buys and 25 sells over 3 months (Nasdaq).

findings.finding: The sell-side reset is under way but not complete. Four houses (BofA, BTIG, Raymond James, Needham) cut before the 2026-10-01 open, but MarketBeat still shows a 12-analyst consensus target of $94.92, so most of the other eight have not yet updated and can publish cuts or downgrades before the 2026-10-02 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Sell-side notes are published before the open. The analysts who have not updated after a 57% fall and a 1-week remedy clock would normally publish within one or two sessions, so 2026-10-02 pre-market is the natural slot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first wave of cuts on 2026-10-01 coincided with a -20.6% gap that the stock then retraced by +10.4% intraday. That tape absorbed the cuts. Targets still above spot ($40-$72 against $26.52) are weaker news than the first wave.
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds the four published cuts. It does not hold any later downgrade to Sell or a target below spot from the remaining coverage. If it did, the intraday recovery off the gap would not have happened.
findings.independence: BofA/BTIG/RJ actions confirmed separately at https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/liquidia-sinks-another-17-bofa-141424498.html ; whether the remaining analysts have updated is not independently confirmed (inference from the consensus target).

outside_window.finding: Form of judgment with each side's proposed remedy, due within one week of the 2026-09-30 opinion. UTHR has asked for an injunction restricting YUTREPIA's availability, and BTIG flags a possible immediate halt across indications. PH-ILD is about half of sales (BofA), and PAH is not covered by the infringed claims. This is the real binary, and on the downside it is the second shoe.
Liquidia's appeal to the Federal Circuit and its sNDA to remove PH-ILD from the YUTREPIA label. Both are announced, neither is dated.
Q3 2026 results. The Zacks estimate is 2026-11-02, which is a cadence prior and not a company announcement.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR submissions (data.sec.gov CIK0001819576): no filing after the 2026-09-30 8-K. No new 8-K, 424B, S-3 takedown or Form 4 on 2026-10-01 at the time of the hunt.

ATM/offering: no 'at-the-market' language after 2025-11-03 (baseline probe). The Q2 10-Q mentions no ATM program. An S-3ASR shelf exists from 2026-03-05, but no takedown is signalled, and cash was $284.2m at 2026-06-30.
Covenant: the HCR revenue-interest facility (about $176m) carries only a $15m minimum-cash covenant per the Q2 10-Q, so the fall itself trips nothing.
Going concern / listing / reverse split / non-reliance: none recent (baseline probes). Price $26.52, far from any bid-price rule.
Company events: no conference, call or presentation scheduled for 2026-10-02 (searched the IR press releases; last was Wells Fargo on 2026-09-08).
CourtListener docket search returned HTTP 429 (the day's 125-request budget is spent; Retry-After 9403), so no in-window docket entry could be checked.
Clinical trials: no primary completion inside the window (L606 Phase 3 2029-07; others 2027).
No post-screen price appeared in any page used. Price mentions in articles were from 2026-09-30 or from timestamps before the screen.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the reaction function: 17x volume (phase 0: >15x gives -2.44% the next session) and the name's own falls (median -1.94%, 33% up). The only in-window item is soft, and the real second shoe (the remedy, about 2026-10-07) sits just outside the window, so p_up is held near 50 rather than pushed to the base rate.
